Left armed, the assignment makes the golden's every boot depend on this qube's loop layout (D2) - and a wrong standing qrexec_timeout corrupts later wedge diagnosis (2.5). Ground truth: HALTED at resettrap-verify, NOTHING sealed on the win10 side. Trap: skipping the readback because the restore commands exited 0, then sealing.
